title: A New Neighbor
paragraphs: A young couple moves into the house next door to Ahmad's family. He watches the moving truck for a while, then decides that it is a good time to introduce himself and welcome them to the neighborhood properly.

He picks some fresh fruit from his garden and brings it to their door. "Welcome to our street," Ahmad says with a friendly smile. The husband is pleasantly surprised and thanks him warmly for such a thoughtful gesture.

They stand and talk for several minutes at the doorstep. Ahmad learns that the couple recently moved from another city for work. He offers to show them around the local market and the nearest mosque sometime soon.

Over the following weeks, the two families slowly become close. Ahmad realizes that a simple act of welcome can open the door to a lasting friendship between neighbors who might otherwise have remained complete strangers.
